title: India's Startup & Tech Growth 2026 | PDF
snippet: India's startup and tech ecosystem is rapidly growing, driven by digital adoption and AI innovation, with Reliance Industries and Tata Consultancy Services leading the way. Overall, sectors such as EVs, AI, and SaaS are expected to continue their growth, presenting significant opportunities for entrepreneurs and professionals.
